text:
PagerBot: :rotating_light: PAGER: service-routing-high-p99 (sev2) — p99 latency > 2.5s for routing-service in us-west-2. Alerts firing: routing-p99, kvcache-error-rate. Paging primary oncall: Alice K.

Alice K: I'm on it, taking primary. quick note: we saw a traffic spike at 22:12 UTC, baseline qps doubled and KV cache eviction rates jumped. Could be cache thrash + slow downstream model variants.

PagerBot: Runbook invoked: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/routing-p99 (steps 1-7). Auto-scaling events: kube-autoscaler triggered 3x pod churn in last 8m.

Ryan M: tagging in as secondary. Initial checks: dashboards show CPU fine, network latency low, but redis (kv-cache) client errors increased ~22:10.

Alice K: Mitigations in progress:
- Added temporary rate-limit on non-critical telemetry route (route: /telemetry/*)
- Enabled degraded-routing flag to route 10% traffic to fallback variant (variant: routing-v2-degrade)
- Clearing suspected hot keys in KV cache for users: run below (careful, only targeted keys):

```
# run from ops jump
redis-cli -h kvcache-prod-usw2 --scan --pattern "hot:user:*" | xargs -L 1 redis-cli -h kvcache-prod-usw2 DEL
```

Alice K: I also bumped the routing service worker pool from 16->24 on the pod template (will trigger a rolling restart). Doing safe drain on one pod at a time.

Maria S: FYI ops-bot reports canary fallback is healthy. No increase in error-rate for fallback. Customer impact: some tail latency for interactive customers in us-west-2; no data loss. Marking impact as "partial degradation".

Sam T: I started a temporary traffic-split rule in front of the cluster, shifting 30% of new sessions to eu-west-1 until us-west stabilizes.

Ops-Bot: Action log: rate-limit applied to /telemetry/* (TTL 10m), degraded-routing toggled, workerpool scale triggered. Links: Grafana panels: https://grafana.redwood/d/routing/overview

Ryan M: Observability notes: enable debug sampling for KV client for 10m to capture stack traces:
```
# enable debug sampling
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/routing-service KVCLIENT_DEBUG=1 --record
```

Alice K: Outstanding alerts: routing-p99 (firing), kvcache-error-rate (firing), kube-rollout (warning). Next steps before handoff: verify p99 < 1.2s for 10m window or rollback degraded change. I'll keep a watch for 15 more minutes.

Maria S: I'll prepare customer comms draft if impact remains >20min. Draft note: "We’re investigating elevated latency for some requests in us-west-2; engineers are actively mitigating. No data loss. We'll update in 15 minutes."

Ryan M: If p99 doesn't drop, we should consider temporarily disabling prefix caching to stop eviction storms: see runbook step 4. That requires coordinated restart window.

Alice K: Current metrics: p95 ~ 420ms, p99 trending down from 2.7s -> 1.8s after degraded-routing. KV client errors reduced by ~60% post targeted key eviction.

PagerBot: Reminder: oncall rotation for night shift starts at 00:00 UTC. Primary for next shift: Sam T, Secondary: Maria S.

Alice K: Handoff plan for night shift (Sam/Maria):
- Primary: Sam T (take PD alerts), Secondary: Maria S (customer comms + escalations).
- Active mitigations: degraded-routing (10% -> 30% if needed), telemetry rate-limit active, targeted hot-key eviction completed, workerpool scaled to 24 (rolling restarts ongoing).
- Outstanding items: monitor p99 for 30m post-restart, watch kube-rollout warnings (pod restarts at ~1/min acceptable), leave debug sampling enabled for 10m (watch for noise).
- Runbook pointers: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/routing-p99 (do NOT run global cache flush unless instructed)
- PagerDuty: PD-INC-4721 is active. Slack incident channel: #inc-4721-routing (auto-join).

Sam T: Acknowledged. I'll shadow for the next 20m then assume primary at 00:00 UTC. If p99 > 2s or kv errors spike, I'll escalate to infra oncall (pd-infra).

Maria S: I'll finalize the 15min customer update and queue it for send if we don't clear by then. Also will create a short postmortem template pre-filled: root cause hypothesis = KV eviction storm under sudden QPS spike.

Alice K: Leaving the thread at 23:02 UTC. Handoff checklist:
- Confirmed degraded-routing toggled and healthy
- Targeted cache eviction performed (keys: hot:user:*)
- Workerpool scale/rolling restart kicked off (monitor pod readiness)
- Debug sampling toggled for KV client
- Customer comms draft ready

Alice K: Thanks team, Sam/Maria — you're set to take over. I'll be reachable until 23:20 UTC if anything regresses. :thumbsup:

Ops-Bot: Incident summary logged to internal tracker: https://tracker.redwood/INC-4721. Incident severity set to sev2, flagged for follow-up.

PagerBot: Closing note: Remember blameless process; please put any odd config changes in the postmortem notes.

Sam T: Got it, taking over. I'll post updates to #inc-4721-routing during the shift.

Maria S: Copy. I'll send customer update at 23:17 UTC unless resolved earlier.

PagerBot: Thread closed by Alice K (handoff) at 23:02 UTC.
